Extraction source: PDF vector paths on page 9. All lines and text in this figure are embedded as filled outlines (no stroked paths, no text layer), so tick labels could not be read from get_text; tick VALUES were read from the rendered page (x: 15,30,...,90 deg; y per panel as listed) and assigned to the 6 tick-mark rectangles found per axis (tick centre positions are exactly equally spaced; linear fit residual ~0).

Curve polylines are taken from the grey fill_between polygon of each panel, whose lower and upper boundaries are the data centrelines of the solid and dashed curves (dense, ~0.37-0.74 deg spacing). They were cross-checked against the centreline of the solid line outline and the centroids of the dash outlines (see per-panel deviations above).

Identification: dashed (upper) = J(u'_FE) (finite-element pore-pressure approach, upper bound of -J), solid (lower) = -J*(v'_opt) (velocity-based approach) per the in-figure annotations in panel alpha=1 and the caption/text.
Values are normalized by k_h H^2 gamma_w^2 (as stated in the text).
Resampled values at beta=15,20,...,90 are linear interpolations of the dense polylines.

Visual check: fig5_overlay.png and fig5_overlay_zoom.png (extracted polylines and 5-deg resampled points mapped back to page coordinates on a 6x render of the page) show the extracted curves lying on the printed dashed and solid lines in all four panels, including the ends at 15 and 90 deg.
Estimated digitization uncertainty: about 0.001-0.003 in normalized-functional units (largest for alpha=1, whose y-range is the widest), and under 0.01 deg in beta.
